title: Inspect Any Crack: An Automated End-to-End Crack Segmentation and Severity Assessment Framework
mechanism: Foundation-model-derived segmenter (SACv2-Tiny), then physical width and area from masks, combined into a bounded continuous Crack Severity Index from max width and affected-area ratio.
adaptation: Template for the EL severity step: width is meaningless (sub-pixel crack), so use crack length, crack orientation mode (parallel to busbar, cross, dendritic) and isolated or inactive area fraction, combined into a bounded index; validate against inactive area and power-loss bands where available.
min_experiment: Post-hoc on PF predictions: compute the index per cell and test whether it separates cells with and without inactive ground truth (AUC) on CV folds. Kill if AUC < 0.75.
evidence: R: SACv2-Tiny F1 62.49%, IoU 45.45% on OmniCrack30k test, mean zero-shot F1 69.89% on three unseen sets; width error 7.33% at 41 caliper points.
